scripts.check: node --check assets/verifact.js && node --check assets/verifact-admin.js && node --check assets/verifact-editor.js
scripts.test:integration: wp-env run cli wp plugin activate --all && wp-env run cli wp eval 'if (!class_exists("VeriFact_Plugin") || VeriFact_Plugin::VERSION !== "3.5.0") { exit(1); } global $wpdb; $table=$wpdb->prefix."verifact_jobs"; if ($wpdb->get_var($wpdb->prepare("SHOW TABLES LIKE %s",$table)) !== $table) { exit(2); } echo "VeriFact 3.5 integration passed";'
scripts.test:large-post: wp-env run cli wp eval '$body=str_repeat("NASA reported a measurement in 2025. " ,2500); $id=wp_insert_post(["post_title"=>"Large VeriFact test","post_content"=>$body,"post_status"=>"draft"]); $job=$GLOBALS["verifact_queue"]->enqueue($id,1); if (is_wp_error($job)) { exit(1); } echo $job;'
scripts.test:multisite: wp-env run cli wp core multisite-convert --title='VeriFact Test Network' && wp-env run cli wp site create --slug=second --title='Second Site' --email=admin@example.test && wp-env run cli wp plugin deactivate --all && wp-env run cli wp plugin activate --all --network && wp-env run cli wp eval 'foreach(get_sites(["fields"=>"ids"]) as $site_id){switch_to_blog($site_id);global $wpdb;$table=$wpdb->prefix."verifact_jobs";if($wpdb->get_var($wpdb->prepare("SHOW TABLES LIKE %s",$table))!==$table){exit(3);}restore_current_blog();}echo "VeriFact multisite passed";'
scripts.test:compatibility: wp-env run cli wp eval 'register_post_type("vf_test",["show_ui"=>true,"supports"=>["editor"]]);$id=wp_insert_post(["post_type"=>"vf_test","post_status"=>"draft","post_title"=>"Builder test"]);update_post_meta($id,"_elementor_data",wp_json_encode([["settings"=>["editor"=>"Elementor verified claim text"]]]));$content=apply_filters("verifact_post_content","",get_post($id));if(strpos($content,"Elementor verified claim text")===false){exit(4);}echo "VeriFact compatibility passed";'
scripts.test:queue-recovery: wp-env run cli wp eval 'global $wpdb;$table=$wpdb->prefix."verifact_jobs";$now=current_time("mysql",true);$wpdb->insert($table,["post_id"=>1,"status"=>"dead_letter","content_hash"=>hash("sha256","test"),"attempts"=>4,"available_at"=>$now,"created_at"=>$now,"updated_at"=>$now]);$id=(int)$wpdb->insert_id;if(!$GLOBALS["verifact_queue"]->requeue($id)){exit(5);}echo "VeriFact queue recovery passed";'
scripts.test:bulk-registration: wp-env run cli wp eval 'do_action("admin_init");if(!has_filter("bulk_actions-edit-post")){exit(6);}echo "VeriFact bulk registration passed";'
